camera is really good if i could describe the last stretch effort is you know how a wall is really a hollow box. well, the camera is just barely clipping the inner half of that 2nd wall that is inside of the building. if that makes sense. so like 


x = player
| = wall
< = camera

it sits like this 

x|<| 

where its not stuck in the box, but its clipping into that part of the wall if that makes sense
resolution: Final-stretch camera polish: in the compiled loader the spring-arm pulled the eye to a wall's CAMERA-facing (entry) face minus skin, so for any wall thicker than the 0.14m skin the eye landed INSIDE the wall box and clipped its inner half (user's x|<| sketch). cameraOcclusionStepColliders now uses a new segmentAabbSpan helper to take the wall's PIVOT-facing (exit) face instead, aggregated by the smallest inner-face distance so a wall near the player wins over the outer shell — the eye settles just on the player's side of the whole wall box. Loader springArmEye unchanged (only the returned reference face moved; it still does clamp(result - skin, min, base)). Needs a loader rebuild (rjit game play/shot). The editor's JS spring-arm shares the same entry-based query and can get the same parity fix later if wanted. Verified: loader builds clean (zig build app -Duse-v8=false), physics 15/15 + cameraOcclusion 3/3, zig fmt clean. Commit 661928f87.
